Their sightings either get an FK to the right species through another name (Zc to sea lion, Zcav to Zica, Tu to TURT-UN, 'Dc or Dd' to Dsp) or keep their text with the species FK left NULL.

Not a change to the list: the filters show every species a sighting of any research group uses, 65 of the 130. Today they show 68, CRC's only; three fewer because sightings of codes today's list made species of their own (Zc, Zcav, Tu and others) now point at the species DB167's list has for them.
